notes.title: Update 1.0.6 - Research system
notes.content:
[h1]📢 Changelog - New In-Game Research[/h1]
 
[h2]🔥 Research Update[/h2]
We've added a new research system to improve gameplay and progression! You'll now be able to unlock strategic upgrades for your company, increasing efficiency, profits, and resource management. Below, we'll show you the new research systems and how they'll impact your playthrough.

 
[h2]🏢 [b]Office[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Computers: [/b]Unlock new purchasing options, from PC Advanced to PC Masters.[/*][*][b]Flooring: [/b]Access flooring packs of different levels, improving the aesthetics and value of the office.[/*][/list][h2]👥 [b]Employees[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Finding new employees: [/b]Speed up your talent search by up to 50%.[/*][*][b]Improve negotiation: [/b]Increases the chances of successfully hiring employees.[/*][*][b]Improve retention: [/b]Reduce turnover and build loyalty among your team.[/*][*][b]Improve productivity: [/b]Boost employee performance.[/*][/list][h2]📜 [b]Contracts[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Improves negotiation: [/b]Facilitates agreements with clients, increasing their success by up to 50%.[/*][*][b]More Contracts: [/b]Increases the number of contracts available.[/*][*][b]Increase budgets: [/b]Improve revenue by increasing contract values.[/*][/list][h2]🌐 [b]Websites[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Module Pack: [/b]Unlock modules to customize websites.[/*][*][b]Component Bundle: [/b]Access components of varying quality to optimize your sites.[/*][*][b]Marketing: [/b]Unlock new forms of promotion (mail, text, images, videos, radio, TV).[/*][*][b]Improve marketing: [/b]Increase advertising effectiveness.[/*][*][b]Infrastructure: [/b]Unlock new technology infrastructures to optimize web services.[/*][*][b]More happiness: [/b]Reduces user dissatisfaction caused by advertising.[/*][/list][h2]💾 [b]Software[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Feature Pack: [/b]Access basic, advanced, and premium packages.[/*][*][b]Better sales: [/b]Increase profits generated by the software.[/*][*][b]More interest: [/b]Generate more demand and engagement with your digital products.[/*][/list][h2] [/h2][h2]💾 [b]Other minor changes or fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Websites [/b][b]: Fixed a bug on websites where module quality and module type would affect user satisfaction, for example, revenue modules negatively affect satisfaction [/b][b].[/b][/*][*][b]Employees: [/b]Some employees were working less than expected due to a coding error, which has now been resolved.[/*][/list]
 

🚀 [b]Conclusion: [/b]This research adds depth and strategy to your business management, allowing you to expand your operations and optimize resources more effectively. Take advantage of these new options and take your business to the next level!

🔜 [b]Coming soon: [/b]Physical Customer Service Offices! More AI improvements for employees and customers, plus new office optimization mechanics. Stay tuned for future updates!

🎮 [b]Thanks for playing! [/b]Your feedback is key to continuing to improve the experience. 🙌

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.0.2[/b]


[b]Hello, players![/b]



 We are excited to present the latest update for DevTycoon. This version brings an overhaul to some mechanics, as well as bug fixes and minor NPC behavior changes .


[b]🎮 [/b][b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Review of website mechanics [/b]: Websites now have a probability of receiving visits that is based primarily on the number and level of website modules, this will lead to the probability of receiving organic visits as work is done on improving the website.[/*]
[*][b]NPC Behavior [/b]: Workers will now try to stay inside rooms instead of walking around the map, they will try to talk and/or do their business inside rooms, however, they will still leave rooms when they want to smoke.[/*]
[/list]

[b]🐛 [/b][b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]: Bug that caused advertising campaigns to close when editing the budget.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]: Daily progress of the advertising campaign was not displayed correctly.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]: Bug that prevented some project details from being viewed after a while.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]: Fixed an issue with negative balance achievements, they were being fulfilled even with positive balance.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Thank you for your continued support[/b] ❤️ 
 As always, we appreciate feedback from our amazing community. Please keep sharing your ideas and reporting issues to keep improving DevTycoon!


Ready for adventure? See you in-game!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 – Improvements and balancing for a more epic experience!
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.0.1 – Improvements and balancing for a more epic experience![/b]


[b]Hello, players![/b]



 We are excited to present the latest update to DevTycoon. This release brings visual improvements, gameplay tweaks , bug fixes, and balance changes that have been highly requested by our community.


[b]✨ [/b][b]Visual Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*][b]New interface to view company details [/b]: Now you can select any company from the “ [b]Companies [/b]” menu and check company details such as products, software, money in the bank, company value, as well as specific details for each software and website.[/*]
[/list]

[b]🎮 [/b][b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Contract Competition Review [/b]: This mechanic has now been balanced so that the user has a better chance of winning contracts, although it is still affected by the reputation of the user's company and the client.[/*]
[*][b]New real competition mechanics [/b]: Now companies will work at the same time as the player to develop new software, improve their software and sell their products.[/*]
[*][b]Basic Needs Changes [/b]: Workers will now work harder and will not need to meet their needs as often as going to the bathroom or eating something, however, this is still affected by the settings selected when creating the game.[/*]
[*][b]Software sales: [/b]Now when selling software, it will have a tendency to decrease sales over the months, reflecting real-life behavior. Sales will progressively decrease depending on factors such as the creativity and interest of the software.[/*]
[/list]

[b]⚔️ [/b][b]Game Balance[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Contracts [/b]:[/*]
[list]
[*]They have been balanced so that the probability is not so low.[/*]
[/list]
[*][b]NPC Needs [/b]:[/*]
[list]
[*]Now they won't need to go as often to cover their basic needs like going to the bathroom or eating.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]

[b]🐛 [/b][b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]: A bug when creating a new character did not correctly display the available skill points.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]: A bug that did not display the texts of some settings correctly when creating a new game.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]: Bug that prevented new software developments from being monetized correctly.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]: Issue with calendar when moving to the next month that causes skipping several consecutive years.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]: Bug that caused the speed to remain accelerated when returning to the main menu.[/*]
[/list]
[b]💡General Improvements [/b]
[list]
[*]Significant optimizations have been made to increase performance on low- and mid-range PCs.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Thank you for your continued support[/b] ❤️ 
 As always, we appreciate feedback from our amazing community. Please keep sharing your ideas and reporting issues to keep improving DevTycoon!


Ready for adventure? See you in-game!
